test_title: PYST 38: SSC MTS 2022 - Reasoning (Held On: 19 May, 2023 Shift 2)
subject: reasoning
question: Seven teachers Anil, Kamal, Ram, Sanjay, Aakash, Vivek and Rahul are sitting around a circular table facing opposite to the centre (not necessarily in the same order). Sanjay is to the immediate right of Anil. Anil is third to the right of Rahul. Vivek is not the immediate neighbour of Aakash. Kamal is second to the right of Vivek. Who is second to the right of Anil?
solution:
As per the given information, the sitting arrangement is:

1. Sanjay is to the immediate right of Anil and Anil is third to the right of Rahul.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/eef16660682fad717878b29c9132f7d60182f7184d4bbb0b9cc0de3767be2add.png] 

2. Kamal is second to the right of Vivek.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f7b83e9e8930f8282b6528b233beca3e153c97f84f4d997a76070210abec667a.png] 

3. Vivek is not an immediate neighbour of Aakash which means Aakash is sitting to the immediate left of Anil. 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c788687813a5ec65509958891357bf294d29397a01cf5162dd4fca22ac45b012.png] 

4. There is only one place left for Ram. So, Ram will sit to the immediate right of Sanjay.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/2987728f0b893ee21d83ec3499d16d999391a0fc5c8a15e6834d6de2c5b8b9cc.png] 

Here, second to the right of Anil is **'**Ram**'.**

Hence, the correct answer is "Option (3)".
